description: Foundation: environment fixups, all 17 database migrations, all 16 Eloquent models with constants/casts/relationships, and seeders. This FEAT has NO dependencies on other FEATs — all subsequent FEATs depend on it.
steps: 1. Fix .env.example: ensure PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET=sandbox-webhook-secret-change-me and APP_URL=http://localhost:8000 (no duplicate port). Verify .env matches. Do NOT touch any other .env values.

2. Create app/Http/Middleware/EnsureUserHasRole.php: accept comma-separated roles, abort 403 on mismatch, check auth()->user()->role. Register in bootstrap/app.php via $middleware->alias(['role' => EnsureUserHasRole::class]).

3. Create migration add_profile_fields_to_users_table: add columns role (string, default 'applicant', indexed), contact_number (string(32) nullable), address (string nullable), is_active (boolean default true). No ->after() (SQLite). Timestamp after the existing 000000 users migration.

4. Create migration create_businesses_table: user_id FK cascade, name (indexed), address, barangay (indexed), nature, ownership_type, dti_sec_type (nullable), dti_sec_number (nullable), number_of_employees (unsigned int default 0), timestamps.
5. Create migration create_requirement_types_table: name, code (unique), is_required (bool default true), is_active (bool default true), sort_order (unsigned int default 0), timestamps.

6. Create migration create_applications_table: user_id FK, business_id FK nullable, tracking_number (string unique nullable indexed), status (string indexed default DRAFT), all snapshot fields (applicant_name, contact_number, email, business_name indexed, business_address, business_nature, ownership_type, dti_sec_type nullable, dti_sec_number nullable, barangay indexed, number_of_employees unsigned default 0), submitted_at (timestamp nullable), reviewed_at (timestamp nullable), timestamps. Composite index on (status, created_at).

7. Create migration create_application_requirements_table: application_id FK cascade, requirement_type_id FK, original_filename nullable, stored_path nullable, mime nullable, size_kb unsigned nullable, checklist_status string default MISSING, correction_note nullable, uploaded_at timestamp nullable, timestamps. Unique index on (application_id, requirement_type_id).

8. Create migration create_application_status_histories_table: application_id FK cascade, from_status nullable, to_status, actor_id FK nullable, actor_role nullable, note text nullable, created_at timestamp useCurrent only (no updated_at).
9. Create migration create_application_remarks_table: application_id FK cascade, author_id FK users, type string (GENERAL/CORRECTION/REJECTION), body text, timestamps.
10. Create migration create_fee_types_table: name, code (unique), is_active bool default true, sort_order unsigned default 0, timestamps.

11. Create migration create_fee_rates_table: fee_type_id FK cascade, label, amount decimal(12,2), calc_type string default 'fixed', is_active bool default true indexed, effective_from date nullable, timestamps.

12. Create migration create_payments_table: application_id FK cascade, tracking_number indexed, amount decimal(12,2), breakdown_json json, method string, reference_number nullable indexed, status string default PENDING indexed, verification_status string default UNVERIFIED, payment_date timestamp nullable, verified_at timestamp nullable, verified_by FK users nullable, timestamps.
13. Create migration create_payment_transactions_table: payment_id FK cascade, event string, gateway string, payload_json json nullable, created_at timestamp (no updated_at).

14. Create migration create_permits_table: application_id FK cascade unique indexed, permit_number string unique indexed, verification_token string(64) unique indexed, business_name, owner_name, business_address, business_nature, issued_at date, valid_until date, status string default ACTIVE indexed, pdf_path nullable, generated_by FK users nullable, timestamps.

15. Create migration create_qr_verifications_table: permit_id FK nullOnDelete nullable indexed, token string indexed, result string (VALID/EXPIRED/REVOKED/NOT_FOUND), ip_address string(45) nullable, user_agent string nullable, created_at timestamp (no updated_at).

16. Create migration create_notifications_table: user_id FK cascade, application_id FK nullable, type string, title string, body text, channel string default in_app, sms_status nullable, read_at timestamp nullable, timestamps. Composite index on (user_id, read_at).

17. Create migration create_audit_logs_table: actor_id FK users nullable, action string indexed, subject_type nullable, subject_id unsigned big int nullable, meta_json json nullable, ip_address string(45) nullable, created_at timestamp (no updated_at). Composite index on (subject_type, subject_id).
18. Create migration create_number_sequences_table: scope string, year unsigned small int, last_value unsigned int default 0, timestamps. Unique index on (scope, year).

19. Extend app/Models/User.php: add ROLE_APPLICANT/ROLE_BPLO/ROLE_ADMIN constants, isApplicant()/isBplo()/isAdmin() helpers, extend #[Fillable] to include contact_number/address/is_active (NOT role), add is_active boolean cast, add relationships hasMany(Business), hasMany(Application), hasMany(Notification), hasMany(AuditLog,'actor_id').
20. Create app/Models/Business.php: belongsTo(User), hasMany(Application).
21. Create app/Models/RequirementType.php: hasMany(ApplicationRequirement).

22. Create app/Models/Application.php: all STATUS_* string constants (DRAFT through PERMIT_RELEASED plus REJECTED). Relationships: belongsTo(User), belongsTo(Business), hasMany(ApplicationRequirement), hasMany(ApplicationStatusHistory), hasMany(ApplicationRemark), hasMany(Payment), hasOne(Permit). NOT fillable: status, tracking_number, submitted_at, reviewed_at (set only in services).
23. Create app/Models/ApplicationRequirement.php: CHECK_COMPLETE/CHECK_MISSING/CHECK_FOR_CORRECTION constants. belongsTo(Application), belongsTo(RequirementType).
24. Create app/Models/ApplicationStatusHistory.php: $timestamps = false, manage created_at explicitly. belongsTo(Application), belongsTo(User,'actor_id').
25. Create app/Models/ApplicationRemark.php: belongsTo(Application), belongsTo(User,'author_id').
26. Create app/Models/FeeType.php: hasMany(FeeRate).
27. Create app/Models/FeeRate.php: belongsTo(FeeType). Cast amount to decimal.

28. Create app/Models/Payment.php: STATUS_PENDING/PROCESSING/PAID/FAILED/CANCELLED + VERIFY_UNVERIFIED/VERIFY_VERIFIED constants. belongsTo(Application), hasMany(PaymentTransaction). Cast amount decimal, breakdown_json array.
29. Create app/Models/PaymentTransaction.php: $timestamps = false (created_at only). belongsTo(Payment). Cast payload_json array.
30. Create app/Models/Permit.php: status ACTIVE/REVOKED constants. belongsTo(Application), hasMany(QrVerification). No update policy ability.
31. Create app/Models/QrVerification.php: $timestamps = false (created_at only). belongsTo(Permit).
32. Create app/Models/Notification.php (App\Models\Notification to avoid collision with framework). belongsTo(User), belongsTo(Application). Cast read_at datetime.
33. Create app/Models/AuditLog.php: $timestamps = false (created_at only). belongsTo(User,'actor_id'). Cast meta_json array.
34. Create app/Models/NumberSequence.php: minimal model for the atomic counter table.
35. Create database/seeders/UserSeeder.php: admin@bansud.gov.ph/Password123! (admin), bplo@bansud.gov.ph/Password123! (bplo), applicant@example.com/Password123! (applicant). All is_active=true.

36. Create database/seeders/RequirementTypeSeeder.php: 5 types (Barangay Business Clearance required, DTI/SEC Registration required, Valid ID required, Previous Permit optional, Other optional) with codes and sort_order.
37. Create database/seeders/FeeTypeSeeder.php + FeeRateSeeder.php: 4 types (Business Tax, Permit Fee, Regulatory Fees, Other Fees) each with one active rate (500.00, 300.00, 150.00, 50.00).
38. Update database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php: call seeders in order (Users, RequirementTypes, FeeTypes, FeeRates), print credentials via $this->command->info().
39. Initialize git: run git init, create .gitignore (vendor, node_modules, .env, database/database.sqlite, storage/*.key), make initial commit with all foundation work.
acceptance_criteria: php artisan migrate:fresh runs with zero errors and creates all 17+ tables
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed runs and prints the three seeded credentials to console
php artisan tinker can instantiate every model and access its constants (e.g. Application::STATUS_DRAFT, Payment::STATUS_PENDING)
All model relationships resolve without errors in tinker (e.g. User::first()->businesses)
The role middleware is registered — php artisan route:list does not error
User model excludes role from fillable attributes
.env and .env.example have non-empty PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET and correct APP_URL
git log shows an initial commit
verification: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed (expect tables created + credentials printed)
php artisan test (existing Example tests still pass)
findings:
COMPLETED. All 19 migrations run clean via `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` (3 base Laravel + 16 feature tables). Seeders print the 3 credentials. route:list resolves (role middleware registered). 2 Example tests still pass. Notes for later FEATs:
- Migration timestamps use the 2025_01_01_000001..000016 prefix series (ordered after the base 0001_01_01 migrations). add_profile_fields_to_users_table does NOT use ->after() (SQLite); columns appended to users table.
- Role middleware alias 'role' is registered in bootstrap/app.php; use ->middleware(['auth','role:bplo,admin']). EnsureUserHasRole reads $request->user()->role and aborts 403.
- User model keeps PHP-8-attribute style (#[Fillable], #[Hidden]). role is EXCLUDED from fillable; set it explicitly in server code (as UserSeeder does: assign $user->role then save()). Constants: User::ROLE_APPLICANT/ROLE_BPLO/ROLE_ADMIN. Helpers isApplicant()/isBplo()/isAdmin().
- Application model: status/tracking_number/submitted_at/reviewed_at are NOT fillable (set only in services). Status constants include STATUS_REJECTED. relation names: user, business, requirements, statusHistories, remarks, payments, permit.
- Models with $timestamps=false (created_at only): ApplicationStatusHistory, PaymentTransaction, QrVerification, AuditLog. Their created_at is in $fillable and cast datetime; set it explicitly when inserting.
- JSON/array casts: Payment.breakdown_json, PaymentTransaction.payload_json, AuditLog.meta_json. Money cast decimal:2: Payment.amount, FeeRate.amount.
- Notification model is App\Models\Notification (NOT the framework table). User->notifications() points to it. The framework's DatabaseNotification is not used.
- qr_verifications.permit_id is nullOnDelete (defined via unsignedBigInteger + explicit foreign()).
- number_sequences: unique(scope, year), last_value unsigned int default 0. Model App\Models\NumberSequence (no relations).
- Seeder codes: requirement_types codes = barangay_clearance, dti_sec_registration, valid_id, previous_permit, other. fee_types codes = business_tax, permit_fee, regulatory_fees, other_fees. Seeded fee_rates amounts: 500.00/300.00/150.00/50.00, all is_active=true, calc_type=fixed.
- Credentials: admin@bansud.gov.ph / bplo@bansud.gov.ph / applicant@example.com, all Password123!, is_active=true.
- .env and .env.example already had PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET=sandbox-webhook-secret-change-me and APP_URL=http://localhost:8000 (no change needed).
- git initialized; /database/database.sqlite added to .gitignore (dev DB not committed).
